title: Bioconductor Africa Seminar Series
text:
The Bioconductor Africa Seminar Series supports the growth of the Bioconductor community in Africa while remaining open to participants worldwide. This page summarises the programme’s reach, participation and continued engagement.
Sessions to date: 12
Topics covered: 8
Last updated: 26 Nov 2026
